notes.title: Darkness Ahead v2.0
notes.notes:
In the beginning of this summer, we started to update our games to a better state on Steam. Whether they are small fixes, a couple outdated asset changes or lighting overhauls. As the last in the line game to be updated, Darkness Ahead received the biggest update on any of our games.

In Darkness Ahead v2.0, we changed the game's visuals completely. With the new stunning visuals, the game also received assets renewal. Outdated assets from 2016 almost completely changed and together with the overhauled lighting, they offer a much better experience. Also, while protecting the progression of the game, almost every part of the game's flow received corrections and optimizations.

New, updated visuals brought a much better optimization. Now players can explore the abandoned plateau with much better and stable frame rates.

Being our first game and a short game, versions before 2.0 wasn't offering a save system. Now, with this update the game has an automatic save system. This way, no matter at which point you are in the game, your progress is saved.

Whether you are a new player to Darkness Ahead or you played the game back in 2016, v2.0 is an update we are proud of and we think you should give it a try!

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Are Now Available!
notes.notes: We're happy to announce that Steam Trading Cards are now available for Darkness Ahead. Play the game to start collecting cards! You can check your profile under 'Badges' to see the complete card list.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Optimization greatly improved.
[*]Added natural night light.
[*]Various design and gameplay adjustments.
[*]Download size reduced to 900 MB.
[/list]

Details:

- Now there is natural night light in the game. With this, vision without flashlight improved in outside areas.
- Big building's look and design (slightly) changed. This and some unnoticable changes about big building improved optimization.
- Game's playable area (landscape) size reduced. Players don't have to walk unnecessary long distances anymore.
- View Distance adjusted. View distance of trees, rocks and grasses is now fixed for all settings. With this change, everyone will experience foliage design the same way without impacting game's performance.
- Static lights of the game now deliver better lighting.

[/list]

Details:

- General optimization of the game improved. But depend on how far your system is to Recommended Specs, you may still want to reduce Graphics Settings in game options menu. Since game starts itself on Ultra Quality.
